docs.title: Overview
docs.text: A modern, asynchronous Python wrapper for the Luduvo API.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Asynchronous: Works well with asynchronous frameworks like FastAPI and discord.py.
  • Clean Architecture: Object-oriented structure that maps API resources to intuitive Python classes.
  • Flexible: Suitable for small scripts, bots, and large-scale backend services.
  • Lightweight: Minimal overhead and dependencies.

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
To Install the latest stable version run the following command: 

python3 -m pip install luduvo

Or to install the latest unstable version of luduvo, install git-scm and run the following:

python3 -m pip install git+https://github.com/StarryDevelopment/luduvo.py.git

Warning

Do not install the unstable version in production environments, as it is untested and may contain breaking changes or bugs.

docs.title: Authentication
docs.text:
Public API requests do not require credentials. Password login has been removed because the website uses an interactive CAPTCHA. Use only authorized sessions obtained through supported platform mechanisms.

import luduvo

async with luduvo.Client(token=access_token, refresh_token=refresh_token) as client:
    me = await client.get_authenticated_user()
    # client.tokens contains the current pair, including rotated tokens.

Keep credentials in protected storage; never log them. OAuth2 identity verification uses the separate OAuth2Client. Token refresh requires a valid refresh token and is subject to the platform's authorization policy.

See the usage guide and migration guide.

docs.title: Migration guide
docs.text:
Password login has been removed. Use anonymous, authorized token sessions, or the separate OAuth2 client.

The following preferred names are additive aliases. Existing callers do not need to migrate immediately.

Existing Client method Preferred name get_authenticated_user get_me get_my_groups iter_my_groups my_inventory iter_my_inventory my_friends iter_my_friends pending_friends iter_pending_friends my_ignores iter_my_ignores my_balance get_my_balance my_outfits get_my_outfits recently_played iter_recently_played conversations iter_conversations conversation_messages get_conversation_messages trade_counts get_trade_counts trades iter_trades site_banners get_site_banners site_promos get_site_promos featured_events get_featured_events official_messages get_official_messages pending_payments get_pending_payments

For groups, use get_roles, get_metrics, get_pending_transfer, and iter_members, iter_bans, iter_announcements, iter_wall_posts, iter_places, iter_store_items, iter_funds. For users, use iter_groups, iter_usernames, iter_places, iter_inventory, iter_friends.

HTTP paths and successful response shapes stay unchanged. Shared pagination now handles absent totals consistently; malformed responses may raise errors instead of being interpreted as empty results. Ban errors are propagated.

docs.title: Public resources
docs.text:
import asyncio
from luduvo import Client

async def main():
    async with Client() as client:
        user = await client.get_user_by_username("example")
        async for group in user.iter_groups().limit(10):
            print(group.id, group.name)

asyncio.run(main())

Prefer get_* for a single awaited result, iter_* for lazy paginators, and search_* for searches. Existing names remain supported. Paginators support async iteration, limit(n), first() and flatten(). The limit mutates the paginator; construct a new paginator for independent queries.

docs.title: Authorized sessions
docs.text:
Use only authorized sessions provided through supported platform mechanisms. Pass token and optionally refresh_token to Client. Password login is not supported. JWT expiration is used only to schedule refresh, not to verify identity. Persist rotated credentials into protected storage before closing a client. Do not share one rotating session among independent processes without coordination.

async with Client(token=access_token, refresh_token=refresh_token) as client:
    me = await client.get_me()
    async for group in client.iter_my_groups():
        print(group.name)
    tokens = client.tokens  # save securely before closing

docs.title: Groups and roles
docs.text:
group = await client.get_group(group_id)
roles = await group.get_roles()
member = await group.get_member(user_id)
if member.has_role(role_id):
    print("Role assigned")

Roles and memberships are snapshots. Fetch again after changes. Mutations require appropriate platform permissions. A 403 indicates access was denied; do not equate it with an empty collection. Check mutation return values and verify server state where necessary.

docs.title: OAuth2 identity
docs.text:
from luduvo import OAuth2Client

async with OAuth2Client(client_id, redirect_uri, client_secret=client_secret) as oauth:
    authorization = oauth.authorize()
    # Store authorization securely, bound to the initiating account.
    # Redirect the browser to authorization.url.
    # In the callback, atomically consume the stored session:
    token = await oauth.exchange(code, state, authorization)
    user = await oauth.userinfo(token)

The callback must use the registered redirect URI and validate the initiating application session. PKCE and state are handled by the SDK; persistence and single-use enforcement belong to your application. Keep OAuth identity tokens separate from account session tokens.

docs.title: Response types and errors
docs.text:
User, Group, Place, Friend, Member, Presence and GroupMetrics are domain models. Less documented resources return JSON-compatible dictionaries or lists, with public annotations in luduvo.models. Unknown fields are preserved; type annotations do not validate every server field. Group analytics includes typed range, freshness and role count records.

HTTP errors are raised as SDK exceptions, except where a method explicitly returns a fallback, such as get_headshot_url. Only GET and HEAD are retried for selected transient HTTP statuses. Mutations are not automatically retried. Use bounded concurrency and respect server limits; the SDK defaults are not a statement of the platform's allowed request rate.

docs.title: Token metadata and persistence
docs.text:
async def save_tokens(tokens):
    await storage.save(tokens.token, tokens.refresh_token)

client = Client(token=access_token, refresh_token=refresh_token,
                refresh_margin=60, on_token_refresh=save_tokens)

SessionTokens exposes unverified claims, UTC issued_at and expires_at, expires_in in seconds and is_expired. Unknown expiration returns None. Metadata must not be used to authenticate users. Refresh occurs on demand, not in a background task. The callback runs under the refresh lock; do not call the same client from it. A failed callback raises TokenPersistenceError and retains the rotated pair in memory. The next request retries persistence before continuing. Calling refresh() while persistence is pending retries persistence instead of rotating again. Persist current tokens before closing; closing clears the in-memory pair. Coordinate refresh across processes and use atomic, idempotent protected storage.

class Client:
    """Represents a Luduvo API client.

    This class is the main entry point for interacting with the Luduvo API.
    It manages authentication, HTTP requests, and access to high-level
    resources such as users, places, and groups.

    Attributes:
        requests: The HTTP request handler used to communicate with API endpoints.
        url_generator: Utility used to construct API URLs for requests.
        authenticated: Whether the client is currently authenticated.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        base_url: str = "luduvo.com",
        token: str | None = None,
        refresh_token: str | None = None,
        timeout: float = 15.0,
        max_concurrency: int = 4,
        max_retries: int = 2,
        max_retry_after: float = 60.0,
        refresh_margin: float = 60.0,
        on_token_refresh: TokenRefreshCallback | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """
        Initialize a Luduvo Client instance.

        Args:
            token (str, optional): Access token from an authorized session.
            refresh_token (str, optional): Refresh token for that session.
            base_url (str, optional): Base URL for the Luduvo API.
            refresh_margin: Seconds before JWT expiration to refresh on demand.
            on_token_refresh: Async callback to persist rotated credentials.

        Example:
            ```python
            client = Client(token=access_token, refresh_token=refresh_token)
            ```
        """
        logger.debug("Initializing Client(base_url=%s)", base_url)

        self._url_generator: URLGenerator = URLGenerator(base_url=base_url)

        self._requests = Requests(
            base_url=base_url,
            token=token,
            refresh_token=refresh_token,
            timeout=timeout,
            max_concurrency=max_concurrency,
            max_retries=max_retries,
            max_retry_after=max_retry_after,
            refresh_margin=refresh_margin,
            on_token_refresh=on_token_refresh,
        )
        self.url_generator = self._url_generator
        self.requests = self._requests

    @property
    def authenticated(self) -> bool:
        return self.requests.authenticated

    @property
    def tokens(self) -> SessionTokens | None:
        """Current credentials, including any rotated refresh token."""
        return self.requests.tokens

    async def refresh(self) -> SessionTokens:
        return await self.requests.refresh()

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<{self.__class__.__name__}>"

    # --------------------------
    # API Endpoints
    # --------------------------

    async def get_user(self, user_id: int) -> User:
        """
        Retrieve a user by their unique user ID.

        Args:
            user_id (int): The ID of the user to retrieve.

        Returns:
            User: A fully populated User object.

        Raises:
            UserNotFound: If the user does not exist.

        Example:
            ```python
            user = await client.get_user(123)
            print(user.username)
            ```
        """
        logger.debug(f"Fetching user with ID: {user_id}")
        try:
            user_response = await self._requests.get(
                url=self.url_generator.get_url(f"users/{user_id}/profile", "api")
            )
        except NotFound as exception:
            raise UserNotFound(
                message="Invalid user.", response=exception.response
            ) from None

        user_data = user_response.json()
        logger.debug(f"Successfully retrieved user data for ID: {user_id}")
        return User(client=self, data=user_data)

    async def get_user_by_username(self, username: str, expand: bool = True) -> User:
        """
        Retrieve a user by their username.

        Args:
            username (str): The username to search for.
            expand (bool, optional): Deprecated. Whether to return a full User object or a PartialUser.
                Defaults to True. This parameter is ignored as of v1.2.0 and will always return a full User object.

        Returns:
            User: The requested user representation.

        Raises:
            UserNotFound: If no user matches the given username.

        Example:
            ```python
            user = await client.get_user_by_username("john")
            print(user.id)
            ```
        """
        logger.debug(f"Fetching user with username: {username}")
        try:
            user_response = await self._requests.get(
                url=self.url_generator.get_url(
                    f"users/by-username/{username}/profile", "api"
                )
            )
        except NotFound as exception:
            logger.error(f"User not found: {username}")
            raise UserNotFound(
                message="Invalid user.", response=exception.response
            ) from None

        user_data = user_response.json()
        if len(user_data) == 0 or "user_id" not in user_data:
            raise UserNotFound(message="Invalid user.")

        return User(client=self, data=user_data)

    async def get_authenticated_user(self) -> User:
        """
        Retrieve the currently authenticated user.

        Returns:
            User: The authenticated user's full profile.

        Raises:
            Exception: If the client is not authenticated.
            UserNotFound: If the authenticated user cannot be retrieved.

        Example:
            ```python
            me = await client.get_authenticated_user()
            print(me.username)
            ```
        """
        await self.requests.ensure_authenticated()
        if not self.authenticated:
            raise Exception("Client is not authenticated.")

        logger.debug("Fetching authenticated user profile")
        try:
            user_response = await self._requests.get(
                url=self.url_generator.get_url("me/profile")
            )
        except NotFound as exception:
            logger.error("Authenticated user profile not found")
            raise UserNotFound(
                message="Authenticated user not found.", response=exception.response
            ) from None

        user_data = user_response.json()
        logger.debug(
            f"Successfully retrieved authenticated user data (ID: {user_data.get('user_id')})"
        )
        return User(client=self, data=user_data)

    async def get_place(self, place_id: int) -> Place:
        """
        Retrieve a place by its unique place ID.

        Args:
            place_id (int): The ID of the place to retrieve.

        Returns:
            Place: A Place object representing the requested place.

        Raises:
            PlaceNotFound: If the place does not exist.

        Example:
            ```python
            place = await client.get_place(456)
            print(place.title)
            ```
        """
        logger.debug(f"Fetching place with ID: {place_id}")
        try:
            place_response = await self._requests.get(
                url=self.url_generator.get_url(f"places/{place_id}", "api")
            )
        except NotFound as exception:
            raise PlaceNotFound(
                message="Invalid place.", response=exception.response
            ) from None

        place_data = place_response.json()
        logger.debug(f"Successfully retrieved place data for ID: {place_id}")
        return Place(client=self, data=place_data)

    async def get_group(self, group_id: int) -> Group:
        """
        Retrieve a group by its unique group ID.

        Args:
            group_id (int): The ID of the group to retrieve.

        Returns:
            Group: A Group object representing the requested group.

        Raises:
            GroupNotFound: If the group does not exist.

        Example:
            ```python
            group = await client.get_group(789)
            print(group.name)
            ```
        """
        logger.debug("Fetching group with ID: %s", group_id)
        try:
            group_response = await self.requests.get(
                url=self.url_generator.get_url(f"groups/{group_id}")
            )
        except NotFound as exception:
            raise GroupNotFound(
                message="Invalid group.", response=exception.response
            ) from None

        group_data = group_response.json()
        logger.debug(f"Successfully retrieved group data for ID: {group_id}")
        return Group(client=self, data=group_data)

    def _groups(
        self, path: str, page_size: int, **params: str | int
    ) -> AsyncPaginator[Group]:
        return paginate(
            self,
            path,
            "groups",
            page_size,
            transform=lambda data: Group(self, data),
            **params,
        )

    def search_groups(self, query: str, page_size: int = 50) -> AsyncPaginator[Group]:
        return self._groups("groups", page_size, q=query)

    def get_my_groups(self, page_size: int = 50) -> AsyncPaginator[Group]:
        return self._groups("me/groups", page_size)

    def get_partial_group(self, group_id: int) -> BaseGroup:
        return BaseGroup(self, group_id)

    def get_partial_user(self, user_id: int) -> BaseUser:
        return BaseUser(self, user_id)

    async def get_presence(self, user_id: int) -> Presence:
        return await self.get_partial_user(user_id).get_presence()

    def search_users(
        self, query: str, page_size: int = 50
    ) -> AsyncPaginator[UserSearchResult]:
        return paginate(
            self,
            "users",
            "users",
            page_size,
            q=query,
            transform=lambda data: UserSearchResult(self, data),
        )

    def search_places(
        self, query: str, page_size: int = 50, *, sort: str | None = None
    ) -> AsyncPaginator[JSONObject]:
        params = {"q": query}
        if sort is not None:
            params["sort"] = sort
        return paginate(self, "places", "places", page_size, **params)

    def search_store(
        self,
        page_size: int = 50,
        *,
        sort: str | None = None,
        made_by: str | int | None = None,
    ) -> AsyncPaginator[JSONObject]:
        params = {
            k: v for k, v in {"sort": sort, "made_by": made_by}.items() if v is not None
        }
        return paginate(self, "store", "items", page_size, **params)

    async def get_store_item(self, item_id: int) -> JSONObject:
        return await get_json(self, f"store/{item_id}")

    async def get_item_variants(self, item_id: int) -> list[JSONValue]:
        return (await get_json(self, f"items/{item_id}/variants"))["variants"]

    async def get_store_categories(self) -> list[JSONValue]:
        return await get_json(self, "store/categories")

    def my_inventory(self, page_size: int = 50) -> AsyncPaginator[JSONObject]:
        return paginate(self, "me/inventory", "items", page_size)

    def my_friends(self, page_size: int = 50) -> AsyncPaginator[Friend]:
        return paginate(
            self,
            "me/friends",
            "friends",
            page_size,
            transform=lambda data: Friend(client=self, data=data),
        )

    def pending_friends(self, page_size: int = 50) -> AsyncPaginator[JSONObject]:
        return paginate(self, "me/friends/pending", "requests", page_size)

    def my_ignores(self, page_size: int = 50) -> AsyncPaginator[JSONObject]:
        return paginate(self, "me/ignores", "items", page_size)

    async def my_balance(self) -> int:
        return (await get_json(self, "me/balance"))["balance"]

    async def my_outfits(self) -> list[JSONValue]:
        return (await get_json(self, "me/outfits"))["outfits"]

    def recently_played(self, page_size: int = 50) -> AsyncPaginator[JSONObject]:
        return paginate(self, "me/recently-played", "places", page_size)

    def conversations(self, page_size: int = 50) -> AsyncPaginator[JSONObject]:
        return paginate(self, "me/conversations", "conversations", page_size)

    async def conversation_messages(
        self, conversation_id: int, *, limit: int = 50
    ) -> JSONObject:
        if limit <= 0:
            raise ValueError("limit must be positive")
        return await get_json(
            self, f"conversations/{conversation_id}/messages", limit=limit
        )

    async def trade_counts(self) -> JSONObject:
        return await get_json(self, "me/trades/counts")

    def trades(
        self, kind: TradeKind, page_size: int = 50
    ) -> AsyncPaginator[JSONObject]:
        if kind not in {"received", "sent", "history"}:
            raise ValueError("Unknown trade kind")
        return paginate(self, f"me/trades/{kind}", "trades", page_size)

    async def site_banners(self) -> list[JSONValue]:
        return (await get_json(self, "site/banners"))["items"]

    async def site_promos(self) -> list[JSONValue]:
        return (await get_json(self, "site/promos"))["items"]

    async def get_presences(
        self, user_ids: Iterable[int], *, batch_size: int = 50
    ) -> list[Presence]:
        """Fetch presence in batches; missing users are not treated as offline."""
        if batch_size <= 0:
            raise ValueError("batch_size must be positive")
        ids = list(dict.fromkeys(int(user_id) for user_id in user_ids))
        result = []
        for offset in range(0, len(ids), batch_size):
            batch = ids[offset : offset + batch_size]
            data = await get_json(self, "users/presence", ids=",".join(map(str, batch)))
            result.extend(Presence.from_api(item) for item in data["presence"])
        return result

    async def discover_places(
        self, *, surface: str = "discover", limit: int = 20
    ) -> JSONObject:
        return await get_json(self, "places/discovery", surface=surface, limit=limit)

    async def featured_events(self) -> list[JSONValue]:
        return (await get_json(self, "featured/events"))["items"]

    async def official_messages(self, *, limit: int = 50) -> JSONObject:
        return await get_json(self, "me/official-messages", limit=limit)

    async def get_subscription(self) -> JSONObject:
        return await get_json(self, "me/subscription")

    async def pending_payments(self) -> list[JSONValue]:
        return (await get_json(self, "me/pending-payments"))["pending"]

    async def close(self) -> None:
        """
        Close the underlying HTTP session used by the client.
        """
        await self._requests.close()

    async def __aenter__(self) -> "Client":
        try:
            await self.requests.ensure_authenticated()
        except BaseException:
            await self.close()
            raise
        return self

    async def __aexit__(self, exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb) -> None:
        await self.close()

    # Consistent public aliases; legacy names remain supported.
    get_me = get_authenticated_user
    iter_my_groups = get_my_groups
    iter_my_inventory = my_inventory
    iter_my_friends = my_friends
    iter_pending_friends = pending_friends
    iter_my_ignores = my_ignores
    get_my_balance = my_balance
    get_my_outfits = my_outfits
    iter_recently_played = recently_played
    iter_conversations = conversations
    get_conversation_messages = conversation_messages
    get_trade_counts = trade_counts
    iter_trades = trades
    get_site_banners = site_banners
    get_site_promos = site_promos
    get_featured_events = featured_events
    get_official_messages = official_messages
    get_pending_payments = pending_payments

async def get_presences(
    self, user_ids: Iterable[int], *, batch_size: int = 50
) -> list[Presence]:
    """Fetch presence in batches; missing users are not treated as offline."""
    if batch_size <= 0:
        raise ValueError("batch_size must be positive")
    ids = list(dict.fromkeys(int(user_id) for user_id in user_ids))
    result = []
    for offset in range(0, len(ids), batch_size):
        batch = ids[offset : offset + batch_size]
        data = await get_json(self, "users/presence", ids=",".join(map(str, batch)))
        result.extend(Presence.from_api(item) for item in data["presence"])
    return result

class OAuth2Client:
    """Independent async OAuth client; state storage belongs to the application."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        client_id: str,
        redirect_uri: str,
        *,
        client_secret: str | None = None,
        timeout: float = 15,
        authorization_url: str = "https://api.luduvo.com/oauth/authorize",
        transport: httpx.AsyncBaseTransport | None = None,
    ):
        self.client_id = client_id
        self.redirect_uri = redirect_uri
        self._client_secret = client_secret
        self.authorization_url = authorization_url
        self._session = httpx.AsyncClient(
            timeout=timeout, transport=transport, follow_redirects=False
        )

    def authorize(self, *, scope: str = "identify", ttl: int = 300) -> Authorization:
        if ttl <= 0:
            raise ValueError("ttl must be positive")
        verifier = secrets.token_urlsafe(64)
        state = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
        challenge = (
            base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode("ascii")).digest())
            .rstrip(b"=")
            .decode("ascii")
        )
        query = urlencode(
            {
                "client_id": self.client_id,
                "redirect_uri": self.redirect_uri,
                "response_type": "code",
                "scope": scope,
                "state": state,
                "code_challenge": challenge,
                "code_challenge_method": "S256",
            }
        )
        return Authorization(
            f"{self.authorization_url}?{query}", state, verifier, time.time() + ttl
        )

    async def exchange(
        self, code: str, state: str, authorization: Authorization
    ) -> OAuthToken:
        """Validate callback state and exchange its code.

        The caller must atomically consume the stored authorization session and
        bind it to the initiating user before invoking this method.
        """
        if time.time() >= authorization.expires_at:
            raise OAuth2Error("Authorization session expired")
        if not state or not secrets.compare_digest(
            state.encode("utf-8"), authorization.state.encode("utf-8")
        ):
            raise OAuth2Error("Invalid authorization state")
        if not code:
            raise OAuth2Error("Missing authorization code")
        body = {
            "grant_type": "authorization_code",
            "client_id": self.client_id,
            "redirect_uri": self.redirect_uri,
            "code": code,
            "code_verifier": authorization.verifier,
        }
        if self._client_secret is not None:
            body["client_secret"] = self._client_secret
        response = await self._session.post(
            "https://api.luduvo.com/oauth/token", json=body
        )
        data = self._decode(response)
        token = data.get("access_token")
        if not isinstance(token, str) or not token:
            raise OAuth2Error("Missing OAuth access token")
        token_type = data.get("token_type", "Bearer")
        if not isinstance(token_type, str) or token_type.lower() != "bearer":
            raise OAuth2Error("Unsupported OAuth token type")
        return OAuthToken(
            token,
            token_type,
            data.get("expires_in"),
            data.get("scope"),
            data.get("refresh_token"),
        )

    async def userinfo(self, token: OAuthToken | str) -> OAuthUser:
        value = token.access_token if isinstance(token, OAuthToken) else token
        response = await self._session.get(
            "https://api.luduvo.com/oauth/userinfo",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {value}"},
        )
        data = self._decode(response)
        try:
            user_id = int(data["id"])
            subject = str(data["sub"])
            if subject != str(user_id):
                raise ValueError("Inconsistent subject")
            return OAuthUser(
                user_id,
                data["username"],
                subject,
                data.get("display_name"),
                data.get("avatar_url"),
                data.get("created_at"),
            )
        except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError):
            raise OAuth2Error("Invalid OAuth userinfo response") from None

    @staticmethod
    def _decode(response):
        if not response.is_success:
            raise OAuth2Error(f"OAuth request failed ({response.status_code})")
        try:
            data = response.json()
        except ValueError:
            raise OAuth2Error("Invalid OAuth response") from None
        if not isinstance(data, dict) or data.get("error"):
            raise OAuth2Error("Invalid OAuth response")
        return data

    async def close(self):
        await self._session.aclose()

    async def __aenter__(self):
        return self

    async def __aexit__(self, *args):
        await self.close()

class TokenClaims:
    """Unverified metadata, never proof of identity or permissions."""

    user_id: int | None = None
    username: str | None = None
    role: str | None = None
    token_version: int | None = None
    exp: float | None = None
    iat: float | None = None

    @classmethod
    def from_token(cls, token: str) -> "TokenClaims | None":
        try:
            data = jwt.decode(token, options={"verify_signature": False})
        except (jwt.PyJWTError, ValueError, TypeError):
            return None

        def integer(key):
            value = data.get(key)
            return value if type(value) is int else None

        def string(key):
            value = data.get(key)
            return value if isinstance(value, str) else None

        def timestamp(key):
            value = data.get(key)
            if type(value) not in (int, float):
                return None
            try:
                value = float(value)
                if not math.isfinite(value):
                    return None
                datetime.fromtimestamp(value, timezone.utc)
                return value
            except (OverflowError, OSError, ValueError):
                return None

        return cls(
            integer("user_id"),
            string("username"),
            string("role"),
            integer("token_version"),
            timestamp("exp"),
            timestamp("iat"),
        )

class Member(MemberRelationship):
    """
    Represents a group member.

    Attributes:
        id: The member's ID.
        username: The member's username.
        joined_at: The datetime the member joined group.
    """

    def __init__(self, client: "Client", data: dict, group: "BaseGroup"):
        self._client: Client = client
        self.id: int = data["user_id"]
        self.username: str = data["username"]
        self.joined_at: datetime.datetime = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(
            data["joined_at"]
        )

        super().__init__(client=self._client, user=self.id, group=group)

        self.group: BaseGroup = group
        self.roles = [GroupRole.from_api(role) for role in data.get("roles") or []]
        self.permissions: int | None = data.get("permissions")
        self.headshot_url = data.get("headshot_url")
        self.status = data.get("status")
        self.banned = data.get("banned")

    def has_role(self, role_id: int) -> bool:
        """Check the roles in this membership snapshot."""
        return any(role.id == role_id for role in self.roles)

    async def add_role(self, role_id: int) -> bool:
        """Assign a role; fetch the member again to refresh its snapshot."""
        return await self.group.add_member_role(self.id, role_id)

    async def remove_role(self, role_id: int) -> bool:
        """Remove a role; fetch the member again to refresh its snapshot."""
        return await self.group.remove_member_role(self.id, role_id)

    @classmethod
    def from_api(cls, client: "Client", data: dict, group: "BaseGroup") -> "Member":
        """
        Create a Member instance from raw API response data.

        Args:
            client: The client instance used to interact with the API.
            data (dict): Raw member data returned by the API.
            group: The group to which this member belongs.

        Returns:
            Member: A fully constructed Member object.
        """
        return cls(client=client, data=data, group=group)

    async def kick(self) -> bool:
        """
        Remove the member from the group.

        Sends a request to the API to kick the member from their associated group.

        Returns:
            bool: True if the operation was successful.

        Raises:
            UserNotMemberOfGroup: If the user is not currently a member of the group.

        Example:
            ```python
            await member.kick()
            ```
        """

        return await self.group.kick_member(self.id)

    async def ban(self, reason: str | None = None) -> bool:
        """
        Ban a member from the group.

        This method removes the member from the group and prevents them from rejoining.
        A ban reason can optionally be provided and will be sent to the API.

        Args:
            reason (str | None, optional): The reason for banning the user. Defaults to None.

        Returns:
            bool: True if the operation was successfully completed.

        Raises:
            UserNotMemberOfGroup: If the user is not currently a member of the group.

        Example:
            ```python
            await member.ban(reason="Violation of rules")
            ```
        """

        return await self.group.ban_member(self.id, reason=reason)

    async def unban(self) -> bool:
        """
        Unban a member from the group.

        This method restores a previously banned member, allowing them to rejoin the group.

        Returns:
            bool: True if the unban operation was successful, otherwise False.

        Raises:
            MemberNotBanned: If the member is not currently banned.

        Example:
            ```python
            await member.unban()
            ```
        """

        return await self.group.unban_member(self.id)

class BaseGroup(BaseItem):
    """
    Represents a Luduvo group.

    This class provides core functionality for interacting with a group,
    including accessing its members and retrieving individual member data.

    Attributes:
        id (int): The unique identifier of the group.
    """

    def __init__(self, client: "Client", group_id: int):
        """
        Initialize a BaseGroup instance.

        Args:
            client (Client): The client instance associated with this group.
            group_id (int): The unique identifier of the group.
        """

        self._client = client
        self.id: int = group_id

    async def metrics(self, *, range: str) -> GroupMetrics:
        """Fetch analytics for an API-supported range using the current account."""
        response = await self._client.requests.get(
            self._client.url_generator.get_url(f"me/groups/{self.id}/metrics"),
            params={"range": range},
        )
        return GroupMetrics.from_api(response.json())

    def _paginate(
        self, resource: str, key: str, page_size: int
    ) -> AsyncPaginator[JSONObject]:
        return paginate(self._client, f"groups/{self.id}/{resource}", key, page_size)

    def bans(self, page_size: int = 50) -> AsyncPaginator[JSONObject]:
        """Iterate raw ban records."""
        return self._paginate("bans", "bans", page_size)

    def announcements(self, page_size: int = 50) -> AsyncPaginator[JSONObject]:
        return self._paginate("announcements", "announcements", page_size)

    def wall_posts(self, page_size: int = 50) -> AsyncPaginator[JSONObject]:
        return self._paginate("wall", "posts", page_size)

    def places(self, page_size: int = 50) -> AsyncPaginator[JSONObject]:
        return self._paginate("places", "places", page_size)

    def store_items(self, page_size: int = 50) -> AsyncPaginator[JSONObject]:
        return self._paginate("store", "items", page_size)

    def funds(self, page_size: int = 50) -> AsyncPaginator[JSONObject]:
        """Iterate group ledger entries (requires appropriate permissions)."""
        return paginate(self._client, f"groups/{self.id}/funds", "entries", page_size)

    async def get_funds_balance(self) -> int:
        data = await get_json(
            self._client, f"groups/{self.id}/funds", limit=1, offset=0
        )
        return data["balance_earned"]

    async def pending_transfer(self) -> JSONValue:
        return (await get_json(self._client, f"groups/{self.id}/transfer/pending"))[
            "pending"
        ]

    async def post_wall(
        self, content: str, *, announcement: bool = False
    ) -> JSONObject:
        """Publish a group wall post using the authenticated account."""
        if not content.strip():
            raise ValueError("content must not be empty")
        response = await self._client.requests.post(
            self._client.url_generator.get_url(f"groups/{self.id}/wall"),
            json={"content": content, "announcement": announcement},
        )
        return response.json()

    async def roles(self) -> list[GroupRole]:
        """Retrieve the group's available roles."""
        response = await self._client.requests.get(
            self._client.url_generator.get_url(f"groups/{self.id}/roles")
        )
        return [GroupRole.from_api(role) for role in response.json()]

    async def join(self) -> bool:
        """Join the group using the authenticated account."""
        response = await self._client.requests.post(
            self._client.url_generator.get_url(f"groups/{self.id}/join")
        )
        return response.status_code == 204

    async def leave(self) -> bool:
        """Leave the group using the authenticated account."""
        response = await self._client.requests.post(
            self._client.url_generator.get_url(f"groups/{self.id}/leave")
        )
        return response.status_code == 204

    async def add_member_role(self, user_id: int, role_id: int) -> bool:
        response = await self._client.requests.post(
            self._client.url_generator.get_url(
                f"groups/{self.id}/members/{user_id}/roles/{role_id}"
            )
        )
        return response.status_code == 204

    async def remove_member_role(self, user_id: int, role_id: int) -> bool:
        response = await self._client.requests.delete(
            self._client.url_generator.get_url(
                f"groups/{self.id}/members/{user_id}/roles/{role_id}"
            )
        )
        return response.status_code == 204

    def members(self, page_size: int = 50) -> AsyncPaginator["Member"]:
        """
        Return an asynchronous paginator over the group's members.

        This method provides a memory-efficient way to iterate through all
        members in the group. Members are retrieved in pages from the API
        and yielded as `Member` objects.

        Args:
            page_size (int, optional): Number of members retrieved per API
                request. Used for pagination control. Defaults to 50.

        Returns:
            AsyncPaginator[Member]: An asynchronous iterator yielding `Member` objects.

        Example:
            Iterating asynchronously:
                ```python
                async for member in group.members():
                    print(member.username)
                ```

            Or collecting all members at once:
                ```python
                members = await group.members().flatten()
                ```
        """

        from ..members import Member

        return paginate(
            self._client,
            f"groups/{self.id}/members",
            "members",
            page_size,
            transform=lambda data: Member.from_api(self._client, data, self),
        )

    async def get_member(self, user_id: int) -> Member:
        """
        Retrieve a single group member by user ID.

        This method searches through the group's members using the paginated
        members endpoint until a matching user ID is found.

        Note:
            This operation may require multiple API requests depending on the
            position of the user in the member list.

        Args:
            user_id (int): The unique identifier of the member to retrieve.

        Returns:
            Member: The matching `Member` object.

        Raises:
            UserNotMemberOfGroup: If the specified user is not found in the group.

        Example:
            ```python
            member = await group.get_member(123)
            print(member.username)
            ```
        """

        async for member in self.members():
            if member.id == user_id:
                return member

        raise UserNotMemberOfGroup(message="User not member of group.")

    async def kick_member(self, user_id: int) -> bool:
        """
        Remove the member from the group.

        Sends a request to the API to kick the member from the group.

        Args:
            user_id (int): The Luduvo user ID of the member to kick.

        Returns:
            bool: True if the operation was successful.

        Raises:
            UserNotMemberOfGroup: If the user is not currently a member of the group.

        Example:
            ```python
            await group.kick_member(123)
            ```
        """

        try:
            response = await self._client.requests.post(
                url=self._client.url_generator.get_url(
                    f"groups/{self.id}/kick/{user_id}"
                )
            )
            if response.status_code == 204:
                return True
            else:
                return False
        except NotFound as exception:
            raise UserNotMemberOfGroup(
                message="User not member of group.", response=exception.response
            ) from None

    async def ban_member(self, user_id: int, reason: str | None = None) -> bool:
        """
        Ban a user from the group.

        This method removes the specified user from the group and prevents them
        from rejoining. An optional reason can be provided and will be forwarded
        to the API.

        Args:
            user_id (int): The Luduvo user ID of the member to ban.
            reason (str | None, optional): The reason for banning the user.
                Defaults to None.

        Returns:
            bool: True if the ban operation was successful, otherwise False.

        Example:
            ```python
            await group.ban_member(123, reason="Violation of rules")
            ```
        """

        try:
            response = await self._client.requests.post(
                url=self._client.url_generator.get_url(
                    f"groups/{self.id}/ban/{user_id}"
                ),
                json={"reason": reason},
            )
            if response.status_code == 204:
                return True
            else:
                return False
        except NotFound as exception:
            raise UserNotMemberOfGroup(
                message="User not member of group.", response=exception.response
            ) from None

    async def unban_member(self, user_id: int) -> bool:
        """
        Unban a member from the group.

        This method restores a previously banned member, allowing them to rejoin the group.

        Returns:
            bool: True if the unban operation was successful, otherwise False.

        Raises:
            MemberNotBanned: If the member is not currently banned.

        Example:
            ```python
            await group.unban_member(123)
            ```
        """

        try:
            response = await self._client.requests.delete(
                url=self._client.url_generator.get_url(
                    f"groups/{self.id}/bans/{user_id}"
                )
            )
            if response.status_code == 204:
                return True
            else:
                return False
        except NotFound as exception:
            raise MemberNotBanned(
                message="Member not banned.", response=exception.response
            ) from None

    get_metrics = metrics
    get_roles = roles
    get_pending_transfer = pending_transfer
    iter_members = members
    iter_bans = bans
    iter_announcements = announcements
    iter_wall_posts = wall_posts
    iter_places = places
    iter_store_items = store_items
    iter_funds = funds

class BaseItem:
    """
    This object represents a base Luduvo item. All other bases inherit this object.
    This object overrides equals and not-equals methods ensuring that two bases with the same ID are always equal.
    """

    id = None

    def __repr__(self):
        attributes_repr = "".join(
            f" {key}={value!r}"
            for key, value in self.__dict__.items()
            if not key.startswith("_")
        )
        return f"<{self.__class__.__name__}{attributes_repr}>"

    def __int__(self):
        return self.id

    def __eq__(self, other):
        return isinstance(other, self.__class__) and other.id == self.id

    def __ne__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, self.__class__):
            return other.id != self.id
        return True

class HTTPException(LuduvoException):
    """
    Exception that's raised when an HTTP request fails.

    Attributes:
        response: The HTTP response object.
        status: The HTTP response status code.
        errors: A list of Luduvo response errors.
    """

    def __init__(self, response: Response, errors: Optional[list] = None):
        """
        Arguments:
            response: The raw response object.
            errors: A list of errors.
        """
        self.response: Response = response
        self.status: int = response.status_code
        self.errors: List[ResponseError]

        if isinstance(errors, list):
            self.errors = [
                ResponseError(data=error_data)
                for error_data in errors
                if isinstance(error_data, dict)
            ]
        else:
            self.errors = []

        super().__init__(f"{response.status_code} {response.reason_phrase}")

    def _generate_string(self) -> str:
        parsed_errors = []
        for error in self.errors:
            # Make each error into a parsed string
            parsed_error = f"\t{error.code}: {error.message}"
            error_messages = []

            error.user_facing_message and error_messages.append(
                f"User-facing message: {error.user_facing_message}"
            )
            error.field and error_messages.append(f"Field: {error.field}")
            error.retryable and error_messages.append(f"Retryable: {error.retryable}")

            if error_messages:
                error_message_string = "\n\t\t".join(error_messages)
                parsed_error += f"\n\t\t{error_message_string}"

            parsed_errors.append(parsed_error)

        # Turn the parsed errors into a joined string
        return "\n".join(parsed_errors)

class Requests:
    """
    A special request object that implements special functionality required to connect to some Luduvo endpoints.

    Attributes:
        session: Base session object to use when sending requests.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        session: CleanAsyncClient | None = None,
        base_url: str = "luduvo.com",
        token: str | None = None,
        refresh_token: str | None = None,
        timeout: float = 15.0,
        max_concurrency: int = 4,
        max_retries: int = 2,
        max_retry_after: float = 60.0,
        refresh_margin: float = 60.0,
        on_token_refresh: TokenRefreshCallback | None = None,
    ):
        """
        Arguments:
            session: A custom session object to use for sending requests, compatible with httpx.AsyncClient.
        """
        if not math.isfinite(refresh_margin) or refresh_margin < 0:
            raise ValueError("refresh_margin must be finite and non-negative")
        self._refresh_margin = refresh_margin
        self._on_token_refresh = on_token_refresh
        self._pending_persistence = False
        self.session: CleanAsyncClient
        self.authenticated: bool = False

        if (
            max_concurrency < 1
            or max_retries < 0
            or not math.isfinite(max_retry_after)
            or max_retry_after < 0
        ):
            raise ValueError("Invalid transport limits")
        self._semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrency)
        self._max_retries = max_retries
        self._max_retry_after = max_retry_after
        self._blocked_until = 0.0
        self._timeout = timeout

        if session is None:
            self.session = CleanAsyncClient(timeout=timeout)
        else:
            self.session = session

        self.base_url = base_url
        self._auth_lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self._tokens = None
        if refresh_token and not token:
            raise ValueError("An access token is required with a refresh token")
        if token:
            self._set_tokens(token, refresh_token)
        self.session.headers["User-Agent"] = "Python/luduvo.py"

    @property
    def tokens(self) -> SessionTokens | None:
        """Return the latest token pair. Treat both values as secrets."""
        return self._tokens

    def _set_tokens(self, token, refresh):
        if not isinstance(token, str) or not token:
            raise ValueError("Missing access token")
        if refresh is not None and (not isinstance(refresh, str) or not refresh):
            raise ValueError("Invalid refresh token")
        self.session.headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"
        self._tokens = SessionTokens(token, refresh)
        self.authenticated = True

    async def _persist_tokens(self) -> None:
        if not self._pending_persistence:
            return
        try:
            await self._on_token_refresh(self._tokens)
        except Exception:
            raise TokenPersistenceError(
                "Token persistence failed; current credentials remain in client.tokens"
            ) from None
        self._pending_persistence = False

    async def _refresh(self):
        if self._tokens is None or not self._tokens.refresh_token:
            raise ValueError("No refresh token configured")
        response = await self._send(
            "POST",
            f"https://api.{self.base_url}/auth/refresh",
            headers={"Authorization": ""},
            json={"refresh_token": self._tokens.refresh_token},
        )
        data = response.json()
        if not data.get("refresh_token"):
            raise ValueError("Refresh response is missing refresh_token")
        self._set_tokens(data.get("token"), data["refresh_token"])
        self._pending_persistence = self._on_token_refresh is not None
        await self._persist_tokens()
        return self._tokens

    async def refresh(self):
        """Explicitly refresh an authorized session."""
        async with self._auth_lock:
            if self._pending_persistence:
                await self._persist_tokens()
                return self._tokens
            return await self._refresh()

    async def ensure_authenticated(self):
        """Refresh an expiring session before a request."""
        async with self._auth_lock:
            await self._persist_tokens()
            if self._tokens and self._tokens.refresh_token:
                remaining = self._tokens.expires_in
                if remaining is not None and remaining <= self._refresh_margin:
                    await self._refresh()

    async def close(self):
        self._tokens = None
        self._expires_at = None
        self.authenticated = False
        self.session.headers.pop("Authorization", None)
        await self.session.aclose()

    async def request(self, method: str, *args, **kwargs) -> Response:
        await self.ensure_authenticated()
        return await self._send(method, *args, **kwargs)

    async def _send(self, method: str, *args, **kwargs) -> Response:
        """
        Arguments:
            method: The request method.

        Returns:
            An HTTP response.
        """

        url = (
            kwargs.get("url") if "url" in kwargs else (args[0] if args else "<unknown>")
        )
        target = urlsplit(str(url))
        if target.scheme != "https" or target.netloc != f"api.{self.base_url}":
            raise ValueError("Requests must target the configured HTTPS API origin")
        if kwargs.get("follow_redirects"):
            raise ValueError("Automatic redirects are not supported")
        kwargs["follow_redirects"] = False
        kwargs.setdefault("timeout", self._timeout)
        method = method.upper()
        logger.debug("Sending HTTP request: %s", method)

        for attempt in range(self._max_retries + 1):
            async with self._semaphore:
                delay = self._blocked_until - time.monotonic()
                if delay > self._max_retry_after:
                    raise self._last_rate_limit
                if delay > 0:
                    await asyncio.sleep(delay)
                response = await self.session.request(method, *args, **kwargs)
                if response.status_code == 429:
                    delay = self._retry_delay(response, attempt)
                    self._blocked_until = max(
                        self._blocked_until, time.monotonic() + delay
                    )
                    self._last_rate_limit = get_exception_from_status_code(429)(
                        response=response
                    )
            if method not in {"GET", "HEAD"} or attempt == self._max_retries:
                break
            if response.status_code == 429:
                if delay > self._max_retry_after:
                    break
                continue
            if response.status_code in {502, 503, 504}:
                delay = self._retry_delay(response, attempt)
                if delay > self._max_retry_after:
                    break
                await asyncio.sleep(delay)
                continue
            break

        method = method.lower()

        if response.is_error:
            # Something went wrong, parse an error
            logger.error("HTTP request failed: %s", response.status_code)

            content_type = response.headers.get("Content-Type")
            errors = None
            if content_type and content_type.startswith("application/json"):
                data = None
                try:
                    data = response.json()
                except JSONDecodeError:
                    logger.debug("Failed to decode JSON error response")
                errors = data.get("errors") if isinstance(data, dict) else None

            exception = get_exception_from_status_code(response.status_code)(
                response=response, errors=errors
            )
            raise exception
        else:
            logger.debug("HTTP request succeeded: %s", response.status_code)
            return response

    @staticmethod
    def _retry_delay(response, attempt):
        value = response.headers.get("Retry-After")
        if value is not None:
            try:
                seconds = float(value)
                if math.isfinite(seconds):
                    return max(0.0, seconds)
            except ValueError:
                try:
                    date = parsedate_to_datetime(value)
                    return max(
                        0.0,
                        (
                            date - datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
                        ).total_seconds(),
                    )
                except (ValueError, TypeError, OverflowError):
                    pass
        return min(2**attempt, 30)

    async def get(self, *args, **kwargs) -> Response:
        """
        Sends a GET request.

        Returns:
            An HTTP response.
        """

        return await self.request("GET", *args, **kwargs)

    async def post(self, *args, **kwargs) -> Response:
        """
        Sends a POST request.

        Returns:
            An HTTP response.
        """

        return await self.request("POST", *args, **kwargs)

    async def put(self, *args, **kwargs) -> Response:
        """
        Sends a PUT request.

        Returns:
            An HTTP response.
        """

        return await self.request("PUT", *args, **kwargs)

    async def patch(self, *args, **kwargs) -> Response:
        """
        Sends a PATCH request.

        Returns:
            An HTTP response.
        """

        return await self.request("PATCH", *args, **kwargs)

    async def delete(self, *args, **kwargs) -> Response:
        """
        Sends a DELETE request.

        Returns:
            An HTTP response.
        """

        return await self.request("DELETE", *args, **kwargs)

class URLGenerator:

    Generates URLs based on a chosen base URL.

    Attributes:
        base_url: The base URL.

    def __init__(self, base_url: str):
        self.base_url: str = base_url

        """
        Returns the full URL of a subdomain, given the base subdomain name.

        Arguments:
            subdomain: The URL subdomain.
            protocol: The URL protocol.
        """
        full_url = f"{protocol}://{subdomain}.{self.base_url}"
        logger.debug("Generated subdomain URL: %s", full_url)
        return full_url

        self,

        subdomain: str = "api",
        base_url: str = None,  # ty:ignore[invalid-parameter-default]

            subdomain: The URL subdomain.
            base_url: The base URL.
            protocol: The URL protocol.
        """
        if base_url is None:
            base_url = self.base_url

        full_url = f"{protocol}://{subdomain}.{base_url}/{path}"
        logger.debug("Generated URL: %s", full_url)
        return full_url
